name: Petrol station (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Petrol station, 24 x 23 m: a 20 x 11.5 m steel canopy on four clad columns with a coloured fascia (blank sign panels) and recessed soffit lights over four fuel islands with two dispensers each, a concrete forecourt, a single-bay drive-through car wash with brush gantry, and a flat-roofed convenience store behind. Enterable: the shop with a checkout counter and registers, shelving gondolas and a bank of glass-door chillers, and a stock room with shelving; the car wash bay is open at both ends.
